rt:param.name: HideBut
rt:param.comment: убрать кнопку Авт./Дист. с окон управления

rt:param.name: BG_StaticColor
rt:param.comment: Имя цвета подложки, если объект не должен быть прозрачным

rt:var.name: MyStrokeWdth
rt:var.comment: Толщина рамок в зависимости от управляемости

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Check_Oper_Rights(OU) && ((OU.PVSuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) == 0) && ((AStat & 1) != 0) Then OU.Command(_Now, IBR_BHA) End If End Sub

Sub ShowVal() If pv_CurSetting == Nothing Then Value_text.text = "Ошибка" body.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK bg_A.visibility = "hidden" bg_H.visibility = "hidden" indic_A.visibility = "hidden" indic_H.visibility = "hidden" l.visibility = "hidden" r.visibility = "hidden" Else Dim ValColor As UInt ValColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv_CurSetting) Value_text.text = pv_CurSetting.ValueAscii() body.fill = ValColor If ShowGoodColor Then If ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then body.fill_opacity = 0.5 Else body.fill_opacity = 1 End If Else If ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then body.visibility = "hidden" Else body.visibility = "visible" End If End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (KKS != "NULL") Then Z0 = BIN(KKS + "_Z0") OU = BIN(KKS + "_OU") If (!requests_allown) Then pv_CurSetting = ANA(KKS + "_" + Signal_Setter_Value) Else VB13 = BIN(KKS + "_VB13") pv_CurSetting = ANA(KKS + "_AA1") If pv_CurSetting == nothing Then Set pv_CurSetting = ANA(KKS + "_" + Signal_Setter_Value) End If End If End If

Dim My_w As Float Dim My_h As Float My_w = _This.width My_h = _This.height Static_BG.x = 5 Static_BG.y = 5 Static_BG.width = My_w - 10 Static_BG.height = My_h - 10 body.x = 5 body.y = 5 body.width = My_w - 10 body.height = My_h - 10 LU_edge.points = "5," + CStr(My_h - 5) + " 5,5 " + CStr(My_w - 5) + ",5" RB_edge.points = "5," + CStr(My_h - 5) + " " + CStr(My_w - 5) + "," + CStr(My_h - 5) + " " + CStr(My_w - 5) + ",5" Al_frame.x = 2.5 Al_frame.y = 2.5 Al_frame.width = My_w - 5 Al_frame.height = My_h - 5 bg_H.cx = 10 + My_h / 6 bg_H.r = My_h / 6 bg_H.stroke_width = My_h / 30 indic_H.cx = 10 + My_h / 6 indic_H.r = My_h / 6 bg_A.cx = My_w - 10 - My_h / 6 bg_A.r = My_h / 6 bg_A.stroke_width = My_h / 30 indic_A.cx = My_w - 10 - My_h / 6 indic_A.r = My_h / 6 l.points = CStr(12.5 + My_h / 3) + "," + CStr(My_h / 3) + " " + CStr(20 + My_h / 3) + "," + CStr(My_h / 2) + " " + CStr(12.5 + My_h / 3) + "," + CStr(My_h / 1.5) l.stroke_width = My_h / 30 r.points = CStr(My_w - 12.5 - My_h / 3) + "," + CStr(My_h / 3) + " " + CStr(My_w - 20 - My_h / 3) + "," + CStr(My_h / 2) + " " + CStr(My_w - 12.5 - My_h / 3) + "," + CStr(My_h / 1.5) r.stroke_width = My_h / 30 Value_text.font_size = My_h / 1.5

rect.rt:event: If Z0 != nothing Then Open_ws_wf_wi("TPTS_IBR_set", KKS + "|" + CStr(HideBut), Operate) Else NoLink(KKS) End If

If Z0 != nothing Then If Operate && Check_Oper_Rights(OU) Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|IBRo|TPTS_IBR_set " + KKS + "|" + CStr(HideBut)) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|IBRi|TPTS_IBR_set " + KKS + "|" + CStr(HideBut)) End If Else NoLink(KKS) End If
If Z0 != nothing Then Open_Win_Uni(False, "rights", "Права управления", "wi_rights", KKS+"|"+CStr(Operate)) Else NoLink(KKS) End If
